title: Agent investigates, then fixes only what is exposed
target: lab simulator: Cisco IOS and Huawei VRP config models
request: Fix the edge ACLs on site-b, core: telnet must be blocked

steps.name: tool
steps.detail: show_config(device=site-b, section=acl) → acl number 3000 rule 5 permit tcp destination-port eq 443 rule 10 deny tcp destination-port eq 445

steps.name: tool
steps.detail: show_config(device=site-a, section=ip access-list) → ip access-list extended EDGE-IN 10 permit tcp any any eq 443 20 deny tcp any any eq telnet 30 permit tcp host 192.0.2.10 any eq 22 40 permit ip any any

steps.name: investigate
steps.detail: Fix the edge ACLs on site-b, core: telnet must be blocked

steps.name: parse
steps.detail: Remediate inbound ACLs on site-b and core to block telnet.

steps.name: audit
steps.detail: 2 non-compliant, to fix on: site-b, core

steps.name: generate
steps.detail: site-b: acl number 3000 | rule 15 deny tcp destination-port eq 23; core: ip access-list extended FIX-IN | 10 deny tcp any any eq 23 | 20 permit ip any any | interface GigabitEthernet0/0 | ip access-group FIX-IN in

result.request: Fix the edge ACLs on site-b, core: telnet must be blocked

investigation.goal: Is telnet reachable from outside anywhere? Fix it where it is.

investigation.answer: Telnet (tcp/23) is reachable from outside on 2 devices: site-b GigabitEthernet0/0/0 (ACL 3000 has no telnet deny, Huawei default permit) and core GigabitEthernet0/0 (no inbound ACL). site-a GigabitEthernet0/0 blocks telnet via EDGE-IN rule 20.
investigation.request: Fix the edge ACLs on site-b, core: telnet must be blocked

intent.summary: Remediate inbound ACLs on site-b and core to block telnet.

diffs.site-b:
--- running
+++ candidate
@@ -12,4 +12,5 @@
  rule 5 permit tcp destination-port eq 443
  rule 10 deny tcp destination-port eq 445
+ rule 15 deny tcp destination-port eq 23
 #
 interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
diffs.core:
--- running
+++ candidate
@@ -6,7 +6,12 @@
 interface GigabitEthernet0/0
  description UPLINK
+ ip access-group FIX-IN in
 !
 router ospf 1
  network 10.0.0.0 0.0.255.255 area 0
 !
+ip access-list extended FIX-IN
+ 10 deny tcp any any eq 23
+ 20 permit ip any any
+!
 end

findings.matched: no rule matched: Huawei traffic-filter default permit
no inbound ACL applied on any interface

result.explanation:
site-b: adds rule 15 deny tcp eq 23 to existing inbound ACL.
core: creates FIX-IN [10 deny tcp eq 23, 20 permit ip any] applied inbound on GigabitEthernet0/0.
NOT touched: other interfaces, OSPF, and ssh/dns/http/ntp/snmp/bgp/https/rdp/ping — verified unchanged.
Risk: MEDIUM — new inbound filter bound on core uplink.

reasons: core: new inbound filter bound to GigabitEthernet0/0
